mainEntity.name: Does it know an outage from a flickering light?

acceptedAnswer.text: It captures what the caller describes and routes by the rules you set. It does not diagnose. A whole-house outage with the neighbors' lights on gets routed one way, a flickering fixture another, and anything with heat, smell or sparking transfers to a person. You read the transcript and make the call.

Yes, the same way it books a service call: it checks your calendar and offers real openings. If inspections and installs live on different calendars or inside field service software, we map that on the setup call before it takes a single live call.

mainEntity.name: What if I want to take the call myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Then take it. The agent picks up only what you cannot: the calls you miss, the calls after hours, the calls that come in while you are in a panel. It is the backstop, not the replacement.
